prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one “best” AI video ad maker — the right tool depends on your use case (social short ads, product demos, synthetic presenters, repurposing long content), budget, output quality, and scale. Below are the top options by common needs plus how to choose.

Top picks (one line each)
- Synthesia — best for realistic AI presenters/avatars and multilingual spoken ads. Great for explainer-style ads where a human presenter is needed.
- HeyGen (formerly Movio/Colossyan competitor) — similar to Synthesia; often faster/cheaper for short presenter videos.
- Pictory — best for repurposing long-form content into short social ads automatically (script + clips + captions).
- InVideo / Canva Video / VEED — best all-around template-based makers for quick, branded social ads with easy editing and stock assets.
- Runway — best if you want generative/creative video effects, background replacement, and advanced AI editing.
- Descript — best for screen-recording, interview-style ads, precise editing and AI voice-over (Overdub).
- Promo.com / Wave.video — focused on marketing/ad templates and distribution-ready formats for e-commerce and small business ads.

When to pick which
- Need an AI person on screen (voice + lip sync): Synthesia or HeyGen.
- Turning blog posts, webinars, or podcasts into short ads: Pictory.
- Fast template-based social creatives (stories, reels, YouTube): Canva Video, InVideo, VEED, Promo.
- Advanced generative effects, background removal, creative composition: Runway.
- Need perfect voice cloning + text editing workflow: Descript.
- Large-volume ad production with brand controls/teams: enterprise plans of Synthesia, Canva, Promo, or Runway.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Output format/resolution needed (vertical/horizontal/16:9, 9:16, 1:1)
- Need for AI presenter or just footage+text?
- Languages and voice options
- Branding controls (fonts, colors, templates)
- Volume and automation (bulk generation, API)
- Budget (free tier vs subscription vs enterprise)
- Integrations (Facebook, TikTok, Shopify, ad platforms)

Practical next steps
1) Pick 2 tools from the list that match your priority (presenter vs templates vs repurposing).  
2) Use free trials to create 2–3 sample ads and measure performance (CTR, CPM, engagement).  
3) Evaluate cost per video, editing speed, and how well the output matches your brand.

If you tell me: 1) your ad length/platform (TikTok/Instagram/YouTube), 2) whether you want an AI presenter, and 3) your budget, I’ll recommend the single best tool and a quick script/template to try.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
